conventions.dyMeters: + = car (and rigidly mounted camera) actually further RIGHT than drawn, along the drawn car right axis
conventions.dyawDeg: + = actual heading rotated to the RIGHT (clockwise seen from above) relative to drawn heading; bounded +-2 deg
conventions.drollDeg: + = camera right side up (body rolled to the left, expected in a right-hand corner); diagnostic only, bounded +-5 deg
conventions.dxMeters: + = car actually further FORWARD than drawn; diagnostic only, bounded +-5 m
conventions.accyG: logger lateral acceleration, + in right-hand corners (sign checked against T1/k13 and k9)
conventions.loss: soft_l1 on point-to-projected-polyline pixel distance, f_scale 4.0 px (pick uncertainty)
conventions.pointEstimates: continuous least_squares (multi-start) seeded by grid search; dy bounded +-5 m
conventions.bootstrapGrids: fixed yaw dy 0.01 m; free yaw dy 0.05 m x yaw 0.1 deg (dy in +-4 m)
conventions.scope: relative to the GPS/heading at the 3 wet training frames (camera absorbs their common error); not absolute GPS truth

circularityInjection.meaning: Training poses shifted right by b, camera refit on the same 3 frames, scene dy re-estimated. slope ~ +1: the scene offset is measured relative to the training frames' lateral error (true_dy ~ measured_dy + slope * training_error).

rollGradientSensitivity.meaning: Body roll = k * accy added to the camera roll (k = 0, the IMU-measured value from imu-roll-gradient.json, and assumed 2/4 deg/g). Camera refit on the 3 training frames for each k; held-out values are diagnostics chosen after seeing held-out residuals, not an acceptance test.

lensDistortionSensitivity.meaning: Pinhole + one radial term k1 (x_d = x(1 + k1 r^2), normalised coords), 5 globals fit on the 3 training frames only. Diagnostic of the camera-model assumption; not adopted.

hierarchicalBootstrap.meaning: Resample training picks (per line) -> refit 4 camera globals -> resample scene picks -> fixed-yaw dy (0.05 m grid + parabolic refine). Captures pick noise in camera fit and scene; does NOT capture the common training-frame GPS/heading error or the camera lateral mount (see circularityInjection).
